name: Classic Who
description: An exiled Time Lord called the Doctor travels time and space in the TARDIS, a ship disguised as a police box, with the companions he gathers along the way. The original series, told in multi-part serials, where the Doctor first meets the Daleks, the Cybermen and the Master.

name: Wilderness Years
description: The years when Doctor Who was off the air, between the end of the original series and its revival. The Doctor lived on in a television film, charity specials and animated stories made for the BBC website.

name: New Who
description: The Doctor returns as the last of the Time Lords, still travelling time and space in the TARDIS with companions from Earth after a war that ended his people. The revived series brings back the Daleks, the Cybermen and the Master, and a new face each time the Doctor regenerates.

name: Torchwood
description: Captain Jack Harkness leads a secret Cardiff institute that catches whatever falls through the Rift, in the darker spin-off made for adults. Its cases run from single alien visitors to crises that threaten the whole world.

name: The Sarah Jane Adventures
description: Sarah Jane Smith, the Doctor's longest-serving companion, investigates alien activity from her attic on Bannerman Road with her son Luke and his friends. Family adventures that run alongside the Doctor's own, and now and then he calls in.

name: Class
description: Coal Hill Academy sixth-formers guard a tear in space and time left behind by the Doctor's many visits, with an alien prince and his exiled guardian hiding among the students. A spin-off for young adults, where the monsters come in through the school gates.

name: The War Between the Land and the Sea
description: An ancient species rises from the ocean floor to claim the planet, and UNIT stands between humanity and the deep. A spin-off told from the side of the people left to defend the Earth.

name: Complete Chronology
description: Every Doctor Who story in one running order, from the first episode to the newest, with the spin-offs alongside the show they grew out of.
